_note: Hand-written short films for the Short film page, shipped by the Extras pack.
This file is also what switches the page on: without a pack that has it, Short
film is locked. Picking one skips the writer; the person changes what they like
on the review step before anything is filmed.
writer: this story is used as it stands, and the person changes what they
like on the review step before anything is filmed.
Same fields as the writer's JSON (see backend/shortfilm.py), plus lead_styling:
the lead as outfit only, used when a character LoRA gives the face. A shot with
the lead is filmed from the lead's portrait; a shot without needs
first_frame, the still it starts from. Lines are English and short.
Camera moves use MiniMax H3's own words (push in, pull out, pan, tilt,
tracking shot, static shot, with small amplitude, at slow speed).
style 'social' (hook_text over the first shot, an opening freeze, no title card, a
last shot that returns to the first picture so the post loops) or 'film'. Night Call is
built for social: its last shot is the phone on the nightstand it opened on.

presets.title: Night Call
presets.logline: At 3:07 AM her phone rings - and the caller ID is her own number.
presets.hook_text: 3:07 AM. Her own number is calling her.
presets.lead: a beautiful 24 year old woman with long dark wavy hair, big brown eyes and full lips, wearing an oversized white t-shirt as a nightshirt
presets.lead_styling: an adult woman wearing an oversized white t-shirt as a nightshirt
presets.lead_voice: a young woman with a soft, sleepy voice
presets.setting: in a small city apartment at three in the morning
presets.look: Dark blue night, the cold glow of a phone screen and a thin line of warm light under a door; deep shadows, fine film grain.

shots.first_frame: an extreme close-up of a smartphone lying face up on a wooden nightstand in a dark bedroom, its screen glowing bright white and lighting the dust in the air, a glass of water and a hair tie beside it
shots.action: The phone vibrates hard against the wood, the screen light pulsing in the dark and the water in the glass trembling with each buzz. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the screen.
shots.sound: Loud phone vibration rattling on wood in a silent room.

shots.first_frame: a dark bedroom at night, rumpled white pillows and sheets, the cold glow of a phone screen
shots.action: Maya wakes in the dark, lit only by the cold glow of the phone, squints at the screen and slowly sits up, her face turning from sleepy to confused. The camera holds a static shot.
shots.speaker: lead
shots.sound: Sheets rustling and the phone still buzzing.

shots.first_frame: a dark bedroom at night seen close, a pillow against a dark wall, cold blue light
shots.action: Maya presses the phone to her ear and holds her breath, listening; her eyes widen as she hears her own voice on the line. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward her eyes.
shots.speaker: offscreen
shots.voice: a young woman's whispering voice through the phone, exactly like hers
shots.sound: Faint phone static and her shallow breathing.

shots.first_frame: a dark apartment hallway seen from an open bedroom door at night, a wooden floor, a closed door at the far end with a thin line of warm light underneath it
shots.action: The line of light under the far door flickers as a shadow moves across it on the other side. The camera holds a static shot.
shots.sound: Silence, then one soft creak of the floorboards.

shots.first_frame: a bedroom doorway at night looking out into a dark apartment hallway, a wooden floor
shots.action: Maya stands in the bedroom doorway with the phone still at her ear, staring down the dark hallway, and takes one slow step forward. The camera tracks backward slowly ahead of her.
shots.speaker: lead
shots.sound: Her bare feet on the wooden floor and a low, heartbeat-like thump.

shots.first_frame: the far end of a dark hallway where a door has just begun to open, warm light spilling out, and in the light the black silhouette of a woman with long wavy hair holding a phone to her ear
shots.action: The door swings slowly open and the silhouette stands perfectly still in the warm light, the phone at her ear. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
shots.sound: The long creak of the door and quiet phone static.

shots.first_frame: darkness close behind, a dark wall, cold blue light rising from below
shots.action: Maya's face in the dark, lit cold blue by the phone, tears in her eyes, frozen as she hears her own voice whisper in her ear. The camera holds a static shot.
shots.speaker: offscreen
shots.voice: a young woman's whispering voice through the phone, exactly like hers
shots.sound: A whisper through the phone, then sudden total silence.

shots.first_frame: an extreme close-up of a smartphone lying face up on a wooden nightstand in a dark bedroom, its screen dark, a glass of water and a hair tie beside it
shots.action: The phone lies still and dark, then its screen lights up bright white again and it starts to vibrate against the wood. The camera holds a static shot.
shots.sound: Silence, then the phone buzzing again.

presets.title: 79° North
presets.logline: Alone at an arctic station, Ingrid hears a dead man on the radio - and his footprints lead from the ice to her door.
presets.lead_styling: an adult woman wearing a sleek form-fitting white thermal suit with a high collar, thin glowing blue lines along the seams and a slim silver harness across her chest
presets.lead: a striking 24 year old Norwegian woman with long golden-blonde hair, ice-blue eyes, flawless skin and full lips, wearing a sleek form-fitting white thermal suit with a high collar, thin glowing blue lines along the seams and a slim silver harness across her chest
presets.lead_voice: a young woman with a low, steady voice
presets.setting: at a remote arctic research station on Svalbard during the polar night
presets.look: Cold blue moonlight, pulsing red emergency lamps and a green aurora; deep shadows and fine film grain.

shots.first_frame: an old military radio receiver on a scratched metal desk, frost on its dials and speaker grille, a small green signal light, a pulsing red emergency lamp beside it, a gloved hand reaching toward the dial
shots.action: The red emergency light pulses and the radio crackles with static. The gloved hand freezes just short of the dial, trembling, then slowly pulls back. The camera holds a static shot.
shots.speaker: offscreen
shots.voice: a man with a calm, hollow voice over the crackling radio
shots.sound: Radio static crackling and hissing, a low electrical hum and the wind moaning outside.

shots.first_frame: a cramped arctic research station control room in pulsing red emergency light, old radio equipment
shots.action: Ingrid stares at the radio in the pulsing red light, her breath trembling and her eyes glistening. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward her eyes.
shots.line: That's Erik. He's been dead for three days.
shots.speaker: lead
shots.sound: A low electrical hum and faint radio static.

shots.first_frame: fresh boot prints in deep snow leading out of the dark frozen sea ice straight up to the steel door of a dark-red research station on stilts, a flashlight beam falling across them, a faint green aurora in the sky
shots.action: The flashlight beam sweeps slowly along the boot prints from the ice up to the door while loose snow blows across them. The camera tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed toward the door.
shots.sound: Howling wind and snow hissing across the ice.

shots.first_frame: the steel doorway of a dark-red research station opening onto a blizzard at night
shots.action: Ingrid pulls open the heavy steel door into the blizzard, snow whipping her golden hair, and strikes a red flare that bursts into hissing light across her face. She steps out into the storm. The camera holds a static shot.
shots.sound: The clank of the latch, the wind rushing in and the sharp hiss of the flare.

shots.first_frame: an extreme wide view from high above of a tiny lone figure in a white suit holding a burning red flare on a vast sheet of black glassy sea ice under a green aurora, the red light reflecting on the ice
shots.action: The tiny figure walks slowly across the ice. Beneath the transparent ice a cold blue glow glides alongside her and passes under her feet. The camera holds a static shot from high above.
shots.sound: Wind over the open ice and a deep, muffled groan from beneath the surface.

shots.first_frame: a top-down close-up of clear black ice lit by a red flare, a gloved hand that has just wiped the snow away, and beneath the ice the pale face of a bearded man in his thirties pressed against the underside, eyes closed, air bubbles trapped around him
shots.action: The gloved hand wipes away the last of the snow. Beneath the ice the man's face stays perfectly still, then his eyes snap open and stare straight up. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
shots.sound: The scrape of the glove on the ice, the flare hissing, then one deep thud from beneath and a sharp creak.

shots.first_frame: a vast sheet of black glassy sea ice at night, cracks glowing cold blue, a green aurora above
shots.action: Ingrid falls backward onto the ice with a sharp gasp, the red flare rolling beside her, as cracks race across the ice around her and a cold blue light glows up through them. She scrambles back on her hands. The camera shakes slightly.
shots.sound: Her sharp gasp, the hissing flare and loud splintering ice.

shots.first_frame: an empty corridor inside a dark arctic research station at night, the steel outer door hanging wide open onto a blizzard, snow drifting across the metal floor, a red emergency lamp above the door and an old radio with a green light on a desk in the foreground
shots.action: The open door bangs against the wall in the wind and snow swirls in across the floor. On the desk the radio's green light flickers on. The camera holds a static shot.
shots.line: Ingrid... you left the door open.
shots.speaker: offscreen
shots.voice: a man with a calm, hollow voice over the crackling radio
shots.sound: Wind howling through the open door, the door banging and radio static rising.

presets.hook_text: A dead man is calling her on the radio.

presets.title: Room 13
presets.logline: At three in the morning a night clerk gets a call from a room her hotel does not have.
presets.lead_styling: an adult woman wearing a fitted black hotel uniform blazer over a white blouse with a small gold name tag
presets.lead: a beautiful 22 year old woman with dark wavy shoulder-length hair, big brown eyes and red lips, wearing a fitted black hotel uniform blazer over a white blouse with a small gold name tag
presets.lead_voice: a young woman with a soft, nervous voice
presets.setting: in the lobby and corridors of an old grand hotel at three in the morning
presets.look: Warm amber lamplight against deep green walls, long shadows, lights that flicker now and then, fine film grain.

shots.first_frame: an old brass service-bell board on a wooden wall behind a hotel reception desk at night, rows of small numbered brass flags, amber lamplight
shots.action: In the quiet one small brass flag on the board drops with a click and its little bell rings. The flag reads 13. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward it.
shots.sound: A clock ticking, one sharp bell ring, then silence.

shots.first_frame: an old grand hotel reception desk at night, a brass lamp, deep green walls
shots.action: Lena looks up from the reception desk toward the bell board, her pen frozen in her hand. She reads the number and her face goes pale. The camera holds a static shot.
shots.speaker: lead
shots.sound: The clock ticking and the hum of an old lamp.

shots.first_frame: a long dim hotel corridor with green wallpaper and brass room numbers, 11, 12 and then 14, a plain stretch of wall between 12 and 14, amber wall lamps
shots.action: The wall lamps flicker one by one down the corridor. Between room 12 and room 14 the plain wall stands in shadow. The camera tracks forward slowly down the corridor.
shots.sound: A low hum and the lamps buzzing and crackling.

shots.first_frame: a long dim hotel corridor with green wallpaper and brass room numbers, amber wall lamps
shots.action: Lena walks slowly down the corridor holding a brass key ring, glancing at each door number. She stops in front of the blank wall between 12 and 14. The camera tracks backward ahead of her.
shots.sound: Her soft footsteps on the carpet, keys jingling and her breathing.

shots.first_frame: a green papered wall in a dim hotel corridor where the faint outline of a door is pressing through the wallpaper, a tarnished brass number 13 just visible beneath it
shots.action: The outline of a door slowly pushes out through the wallpaper and the brass number 13 surfaces as if from under water. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
shots.sound: Paper tearing slowly and a deep creak of old wood.

shots.first_frame: a dim hotel corridor, a green papered wall with the outline of a door pressing through
shots.action: Lena backs away with her hand over her mouth as a slow knock comes from inside the wall, then another. The keys slip from her hand. The camera shakes slightly.
shots.sound: Two slow knocks from inside the wall and the keys hitting the floor.

shots.first_frame: a hotel reception desk at night seen from behind, an old brass bell on the counter, the bell board behind it, the lobby empty and amber-lit
shots.action: One by one every brass flag on the board drops with a click and the little bells ring together, then the bell on the counter rings once by itself. The camera holds a static shot.
shots.line: Room thirteen would like to check out.
shots.speaker: offscreen
shots.voice: an old man with a dry, polite whisper
shots.sound: A cascade of ringing bells, then a single ring of the desk bell.

presets.hook_text: Her hotel doesn't have a room 13.

presets.title: Wrong Wedding
presets.logline: A bridesmaid sprints in with the rings - to the wrong wedding.
presets.lead_styling: an adult woman wearing a fitted dusty-pink satin bridesmaid dress, her hair in a loose updo
presets.lead: a gorgeous 26 year old woman with long honey-blonde hair in a loose updo, green eyes and a bright smile, wearing a fitted dusty-pink satin bridesmaid dress
presets.lead_voice: a young woman with a bright, breathless voice
presets.setting: at an old white stone church on a sunny summer afternoon in Norway
presets.look: Bright warm sunlight, soft pastel colours, clean and cheerful.

shots.first_frame: a sunny cobbled church square in front of an old white stone church in summer
shots.action: Sofie sprints across the cobbled church square in her pink satin dress, holding a small velvet ring box high, one high-heeled shoe in her other hand. The camera tracks backward ahead of her.
shots.line: I've got the rings! I've got the rings!
shots.speaker: lead
shots.sound: Her bare feet and one heel clattering on cobblestones, church bells ringing.

shots.first_frame: the open wooden doors of an old white stone church seen from inside, guests in suits and summer dresses standing in the pews, flowers along the aisle, bright sunlight in the doorway
shots.action: The heavy doors swing open and every guest turns around at once to look toward the doorway. The camera holds a static shot.
shots.sound: The doors creaking, an organ stopping mid-note and a murmur running through the guests.

shots.first_frame: the aisle of an old white stone church, guests in the pews, flowers, bright sunlight
shots.action: Sofie hurries down the aisle out of breath and holds the ring box high above her head with a big triumphant smile. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at fast speed.
shots.speaker: lead
shots.sound: Her quick footsteps on stone and a gasp from the guests.

shots.first_frame: a bride and groom in their eighties standing at a flower-covered altar in an old church, both staring toward the camera in surprise, the groom in round glasses
shots.action: The elderly couple at the altar blink slowly in surprise. The old groom pushes his glasses up his nose. The camera holds a static shot.
shots.sound: A long awkward silence and someone coughing.

shots.first_frame: the front of an old church, a flower-covered altar, guests in the pews
shots.action: Sofie's smile freezes. She slowly lowers the ring box and looks around at the strangers. The camera holds a static shot.
shots.speaker: lead
shots.sound: Silence and a single cough.

shots.first_frame: the front pew of an old church in sunlight, flowers on the aisle
shots.action: Sofie sits in the front pew between two smiling elderly guests, holding a plate with a slice of wedding cake, and shrugs at the camera with a sheepish grin. The camera holds a static shot.
shots.speaker: lead
shots.sound: Soft organ music and quiet happy chatter.

presets.hook_text: She ran into the wrong wedding. With the rings.

presets.lead: a stunning 25 year old woman with long dark glossy hair, smoky eyes and bronzed skin, wearing a flowing liquid-gold silk evening dress
presets.lead_voice: a young woman with a warm, low, intimate voice
presets.setting: on a glass rooftop terrace above a city at golden hour
presets.look: Golden-hour sun, warm amber and deep black, slow elegant motion, a luxury fashion film.

shots.first_frame: warm golden-hour light and a softly blurred city skyline behind

shots.speaker: lead
shots.sound: A low warm hum swelling.

presets.hook_text: She only ordered champagne.
presets.lead: a beautiful 26 year old woman with long dark glossy hair, dark brown eyes, full lips and a slim figure, wearing a short black silk robe
presets.lead_styling: an adult woman wearing a short black silk robe
presets.lead_voice: a young woman with a low, warm voice

shots.first_frame: an extreme close-up of a silver room service tray on a trolley in a dim hotel corridor, a bottle of champagne sweating in an ice bucket and two crystal glasses, warm light from a wall sconce

shots.sound: Two firm knocks on a heavy door, glass chiming, the hum of a quiet hotel corridor.

shots.first_frame: the open doorway of a luxury hotel suite at night, warm lamp light inside and the city glowing through the windows behind
shots.action: Elena opens the door and leans against the frame, her silk robe loosely tied, and looks him up and down with a slow smile. The camera holds a static shot.
shots.speaker: lead
shots.sound: The door latch clicking open, the soft city hum from inside the suite.

shots.first_frame: a close-up of a man's hands pouring champagne into two crystal glasses on a glass table in a dim hotel suite, the city lights blurred behind

shots.sound: Champagne fizzing and pouring, a silk belt dropping softly.

shots.first_frame: a close-up of Elena and the man standing by the floor-to-ceiling window of the hotel suite at night, her silk robe falling open, their faces almost touching, the city lights behind them
shots.sound: Breathing, silk rustling, the distant city.

shots.first_frame: Elena naked, kneeling on the thick carpet in front of the man, who sits on the edge of the white hotel bed with his trousers open, her dark hair falling over her shoulders, warm lamp light
shots.sound: Wet sounds, his low groan, sheets shifting.

shots.first_frame: Elena naked, straddling the man on the white hotel bed facing away from him and toward the camera, her hands on his thighs, the city lights through the window behind them
shots.sound: Skin against skin, her moans rising, the bed creaking.

shots.first_frame: a tangle of white sheets on a hotel bed at night, warm lamp light, the city glowing through the windows

shots.speaker: lead
shots.sound: Her breathless laugh, then two firm knocks on the door.

shots.first_frame: Sofia standing on the sunlit villa terrace in her thin white linen sundress, one hand at the strap on her shoulder, the golden sea behind her

shots.first_frame: Sofia naked, lying back on a white cushioned daybed on the terrace with her legs parted, golden sunset light across her body, the sea glittering behind

presets.title: Tidefall
presets.logline: A courier on a hover-bike has thirty seconds to carry the last seed on Earth across a city the sea is swallowing.
presets.hook_text: She has 30 seconds to outrun the sea.
presets.lead: a striking 24 year old courier with a sharp silver-white undercut, dark brown skin, amber eyes, a scuffed orange flight jacket over a black bodysuit and a glowing blue visor pushed up on her forehead
presets.lead_styling: an adult courier in a scuffed orange flight jacket over a black bodysuit, a glowing blue visor pushed up on her forehead
presets.lead_voice: a young woman with a quick, confident voice
presets.setting: in a half-flooded neon megacity of the future, its streets turned into canals between glass towers
presets.look: Teal water and magenta neon under a storm-dark sky, rain streaks and spray, high contrast, anamorphic flares.

shots.first_frame: a wide aerial shot of a neon megacity half under water at dusk, canals between glass towers, and far out at sea a towering wall of water rising on the horizon
shots.action: The wall of water rolls toward the city, lifting the boats in the outer canals as warning lights flash red along the towers. The camera pushes in slowly with large amplitude toward the wave.
shots.sound: A deep rising rumble, sirens wailing across the water.

shots.first_frame: a rain-soaked rooftop landing pad with a sleek white hover-bike, neon signs glowing far below
shots.action: Nova snaps her visor down, swings onto the hover-bike and clutches a small glowing case to her chest as the engines whine awake. The camera holds a static shot.
shots.speaker: lead
shots.sound: Engines whining up, rain hammering metal.

shots.first_frame: an extreme close-up of a small glass case glowing green, holding a single seed in clear gel, rain beading on the glass
shots.action: The seed inside the case pulses with soft green light as the case shakes with the engine's vibration. The camera holds a static shot.
shots.sound: A low hum from the case, the engine roar muffled.

shots.first_frame: a narrow neon canal between glass towers, the water rippling, signs reflected in it, a floating market stall at the side
shots.action: Nova shoots down the canal on the hover-bike a metre above the water, carving around a floating market stall as spray fans out behind her. The camera tracks alongside at high speed.
shots.sound: Engine scream, water spray, shouts from the stall.

shots.first_frame: a low-angle wide shot looking up at a giant wave curling over the outer towers of a neon city, debris and spray in the air, red lights flashing
shots.action: The wave crashes over the outer towers, glass bursting outward and water surging into the canals. The camera tilts up with small amplitude.
shots.sound: A thunderous crash, glass shattering, roaring water.

shots.first_frame: the glowing open hatch of a seed vault high on a glass tower, white light pouring out over a narrow landing ledge, storm sky behind
shots.action: Nova leaps from the hover-bike onto the ledge, rolls, and slams the glowing case into the vault's slot just as spray washes over her. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at fast speed.
shots.speaker: lead
shots.sound: A metal clunk, the hiss of sealing doors, roaring water below.

shots.first_frame: a wide aerial shot of a neon megacity half under water at dusk, the canals calm again, a single green light glowing at the top of one tower
shots.action: The water settles in the canals and a green light blooms at the top of the vault tower, then far out on the horizon a second wave begins to rise. The camera pushes in slowly toward the horizon.
shots.sound: Water calming, then the deep rumble rising again.

presets.hook_text: They have never spoken. Only paper planes.

presets.lead_styling: an adult woman in an oversized cream knit sweater
presets.lead_voice: a young woman with a soft, amused voice

shots.first_frame: a wide shot of a narrow Paris street at golden hour, two wrought-iron balconies facing each other across it, flower boxes and string lights

shots.first_frame: a small wrought-iron balcony with red geraniums and a cup of tea on the railing, golden evening light

shots.first_frame: a balcony railing with geraniums, a pen and an open notebook on a little iron table, warm light

shots.speaker: lead
shots.sound: Sheets rustling, the shower running, a paper note unfolding.

shots.first_frame: a dark open-plan office at night, steel shelves stacked with rows of small silver computers, their status lights blinking, empty desks and chairs, cold fluorescent light
shots.action: Rows of small computers blink in the dark office; nothing else moves. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.first_frame: a big grey beanbag on the office floor under a desk, two monitors glowing above it

shots.first_frame: an empty office chair slowly turning in front of a glowing desk at night

shots.first_frame: a sleepy young woman in a grey hoodie half-sitting up on a beanbag in a dark office, monitor light on her face

shots.first_frame: a hallway of server shelves in a dark office, every status light turning green in a wave

shots.first_frame: rows of server racks with their status lights blinking green in a wave

shots.first_frame: a woman's face in cold blue light against black servers

shots.first_frame: a small printer on a steel shelf in the datacenter, a paper tag sliding out
